title: Concept: vcpkg overlay port directory
description: vcpkg-configuration.json declares an `overlay-ports` entry that replaces registry ports with local files, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads an `overlay-ports` entry that replaces registry ports with local files.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through vcpkg-configuration.json (vcpkg).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads an `overlay-ports` entry that replaces registry ports with local files.
